name: week
title: Monday compliance review
subtitle: Recorded dates are UTC. A record check, not dispatch clearance.

sections.title: Loads that cannot go
sections.note: A planned trip on a vehicle or trailer with an open major defect.
sections.sql: select x.vehicle,x.code as defect,x.description,t.code as trip,t.departs_at,t.customer from open_defects x join vehicles v on v.code=x.vehicle join trips t on (t.vehicle_id=v.id or t.trailer_id=v.id) and t.status='planned' where x.severity='major' and x.status='open' order by t.departs_at

sections.title: Services due
sections.sql: select code as vehicle,rego,km_remaining as km_left,next_service_on as service_by,days_remaining as days_left from service_due where km_remaining<=3000 or days_remaining<=30 order by days_remaining

sections.title: Licences, medicals and training expiring in 30 days
sections.sql: select driver,name as credential,expires_on,days_left from credential_status where expires_on is null or expires_on<=current_date+30 order by expires_on nulls first

sections.title: Incident actions open
sections.sql: select code,occurred_on,kind,corrective_action,action_due from incident_actions where closed_on is null order by action_due

name: fleet
title: Fleet maintenance
subtitle: What an accreditation auditor asks to see first.

sections.title: Open defects
sections.sql: select code,vehicle,severity,reported_on,reported_by,days_open,description from open_defects order by severity,days_open desc

sections.title: Registration and inspection
sections.sql: select code,rego,name,rego_due,inspection_due from vehicles where status<>'retired' order by rego_due nulls first

sections.title: Maintenance spend, last 12 months
sections.sql: select v.code as vehicle,v.name,count(s.id)::int as jobs,coalesce(sum(s.cost_cents),0)::int as cost_cents from vehicles v left join services s on s.vehicle_id=v.id and s.done_on>=current_date-365 where v.status<>'retired' group by v.id order by cost_cents desc

name: loads
title: Mass and restraint
subtitle: Recorded weights against the limit recorded for each combination and route.

sections.title: Over the recorded limit
sections.sql: select code,customer,departs_at,vehicle,carrier,mass_limit_kg,gross_mass_kg,over_pct,mass_category from trip_mass where mass_category not in ('within limit','not weighed') order by over_pct desc

sections.title: No weight or no restraint check
sections.sql: select code,customer,departs_at,vehicle,carrier,mass_category,restraint_checked from trip_mass where status in ('departed','delivered') and (mass_category='not weighed' or not restraint_checked) order by departs_at desc

sections.title: Subcontractors to review
sections.sql: select name,accreditation,insurance_due,cor_acknowledged_on,last_review_on,open_trips from subcontractor_status where status='active' order by insurance_due nulls first
